mapper.insert: INSERT INTO condition_sensor (year, equip_name, sensor_type, zone_name, change_date, next_change_date, remark, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{year}, #{equipName}, #{sensorType}, #{zoneName}, #{changeDate}, #{nextChangeDate}, #{remark}, #{regUserName})
